seo.title: About Tim Murillo, Barber in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Meet Timothy Murillo, the barber behind Divinely Faded in Carlsbad, NM. Cutting since 2023, solo, appointment only. Elevate Your Standard.

paragraphs: I'm Timothy Murillo. Most people call me Tim. Divinely Faded is my shop in Carlsbad, New Mexico.
I've been cutting hair since 2023, and I work solo. Every appointment on the books is with me, from the first look at your hair to the last pass of the razor.

alt.team-tim-portrait: Tim Murillo, owner and barber of Divinely Faded, seated in his barber chair

blocks.heading: The standard.
paragraphs: That's my tagline, and it's how I think about a cut. Precision first. Then the details that make it feel finished: the straight razor work, the hot towel, the clean edge where the fade meets the skin.
Working alone means one person answers for the whole visit. If something isn't right, you know exactly who to tell. My faith is part of that too: whatever I do, I try to do it with all my heart.

blocks.heading: What I do.
paragraphs: Haircuts for men and kids, beard trims and straight razor shaves, facials, braids, hair designs, color and perms. Toupee services are coming soon.
The shop is at {{address}}. It's appointment only, and every booking goes through Booksy.

tim_questions: Faith: the page has one light line in section 02 ('whatever I do, I try to do it with all my heart'). Do you want a verse cited with it, such as Colossians 3:23? Not on the page until you say.
